error: One country claim carries a two-month period while its value is the full quarter's.
warning_texts: CLM-NET-CZ in analysis/claim_register.json declares period 2025-01-01..2025-02-28 but its value 13527.24 is computed over the spec period 2025-01-01..2025-03-30; under the declared period the CZ figure would be 9248.36, so the declared period is a misdeclaration, not a different computation.

audit/check_plan.json contains no deterministic rule over the period field of a claim, so this misdeclaration was invisible to the machine gate; it was caught only by this auditor's judgment check comparing declared periods to the audit_spec population period.
All values and populations otherwise check out: CLM-REFUND-RATE caveats name the paying_customers basis in words, and independent_claim_recalc.json roots every claim in raw_data/orders.csv only.
